correctness.rationale: The monomial norm makes Je_n=sqrt(n+m+1)e_{n+1}. Expanding T*T-TT* on finite polynomial sequences yields diagonal P+(n+m)G for n>=1, vacuum (m+1)P, and second-neighbor coefficients ~nK. For high-frequency long packets (length floor sqrt N), positivity forces each Hermitian M(theta)=G+e^{-2i theta}K+e^{2i theta}K*>=0. tr G=tr K=0 identically so positivity implies M(theta)=0, hence Fourier coefficients G=K=0. Then remaining bounded core form is (I+mE00)tensor P, with P>=0 necessary/sufficient; closure follows by Cauchy control of T* and closed adjoint. Independently reconstructed 2x2 nonnormal matrices A=N-3I,B=N* -2I: P=[[5,-1],[-1,5]], eigenvalues 4,6, G=K=0 and [A,B]!=0; checked exact diagonal blocks for m=0,1,4 at several fibers. Essential spectrum assertion is for bounded FORM extension, not unbounded products.
